scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-local-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-public-assets.mjs && cross-env PUBLIC_ASSET_MODE=PREVIEW astro dev
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-local-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-public-assets.mjs && cross-env PUBLIC_ASSET_MODE=PREVIEW astro build && node scripts/check-project-publication.mjs --mode=preview
scripts.build:public: node scripts/clean-public-preview-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-public-assets.mjs && cross-env PUBLIC_ASSET_MODE=PUBLIC astro build && node scripts/check-project-publication.mjs --mode=public
